name: Hermes WebUI
author: nesquena
description: Hermes WebUI is a lightweight, dark-themed web interface that connects to your existing Hermes Agent gateway, sharing sessions and history with the CLI and other interfaces. It provides near-complete parity with the CLI experience via a three-panel layout with session management, chat, and workspace file browsing. Use it in any browser, or pair it with the Hermes Agent Mobile iOS app by setting a password.

form_fields.label: Hermes Home Host Path
form_fields.hint: Absolute path to your Hermes home directory on this host (e.g. /home/youruser/.hermes). Bind-mounted into the container so the WebUI can import the hermes-agent source it finds at <path>/hermes-agent. Without this, skills, MCPs, crons, and kanban return errors in the UI.

form_fields.label: Gateway URL
form_fields.hint: URL of your existing Hermes Agent gateway (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8642). Use the gateway port (default 8642), not the dashboard port (9119).

form_fields.label: Gateway API Key
form_fields.hint: Bearer token matching the gateway's API_SERVER_KEY (from ~/.hermes/.env on the gateway host). Required if the gateway has API_SERVER_KEY set.

form_fields.label: WebUI Password
form_fields.hint: Password to log in to this web UI (separate from the gateway key). Required when using Hermes Agent Mobile (iOS app).

form_fields.label: Default Model
form_fields.hint: Optional model override (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave blank to use the agent's configured default.
